name: Gentleness
overview: Scripture reveals gentleness as a Christlike quality characterized by meekness, humility, and care, exemplified by Jesus who invites us to learn from His meek and lowly heart to find true rest (Matthew 11:29). The Psalms affirm that God's gentleness uplifts and multiplies His people (Psalms 18:35), while Isaiah depicts the Lord tenderly leading and carrying His flock (Isaiah 40:11). Gentleness is also a fruit of the Spirit that believers are called to embody in their relationships, restoring others with meekness and humility to reflect Christ’s character (Galatians 5:22; Galatians 6:1). Proverbs further underscores gentleness as a powerful means to defuse anger and promote peace (Proverbs 15:1).
